summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing for Sambhrama. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_sambhrama.py — 30/30 pytest tests now pass, including 7 new tests for GET /api/portfolio/{id} (200 + 404), seed contains rich case-study data (long_description + >=2 highlights + >=1 gallery), POST/PUT /api/admin/portfolio with new fields (location, guest_count, long_description, highlights[], gallery[]), backward-compat (omitting new fields still creates), and POST /api/bookings under 3s with RESEND_API_KEY active. All original regression tests (auth, public reads, bookings, newsletter, admin CRUD) still pass. Frontend: partner-logo-0..15 (16 unique * 2 dup = 32 elements) render real SVG content (innerHTML 468 chars on logo-0 — not empty). Portfolio gallery + lightbox open; lightbox-case-study-link routes to /portfolio/{id}. CaseStudy page renders case-study-page/title/long-description/highlights/gallery/back/cta testids. /portfolio/non-existent-id correctly shows case-study-not-found. Admin login works; Portfolio tab exposes all 5 new form fields (portfolio-form-location/-guests/-long-description/-highlights/-gallery). Submitting created a portfolio item that was visible at /portfolio/{newId} with the new fields rendered correctly. Test item cleaned up via API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — seed_content() correctly detects schema drift (missing long_description) and re-seeds. Good migration approach for a small site.
send_booking_email is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task; errors only logged, booking POST never blocked. Verified <3s end-to-end with real Resend key configured.

PortfolioCreate uses model_dump() on PUT — replaces all fields including new ones with defaults if omitted. That's by design here (admin form submits the full doc), but downstream callers should be aware: a partial PUT is not supported.
CaseStudy.jsx — clean component, proper use of testids, gallery fallback to single image_url when gallery is empty (correct). useEffect calls window.scrollTo on every id change.
Partners.jsx — inline SVG wordmarks; readable, brand-safe (not actual logos), data-testid='partner-logo-{i}' on the wrapper for each rendered logo. 16 visible (8 unique x 2 duplicates), index 0-15.
server.py CORS allow_origins still hardcodes localhost:3000 in addition to FRONTEND_URL env. Acceptable for preview.
